description: Write an MLS-ready real estate listing (headline, 120-180 word description, social caption) from property facts, in English, Korean or Spanish. Fair-Housing-safe wording (describes the property, never the ideal buyer; 'primary bedroom' not 'master'). Does not invent facts. Free: 3 per day. Unlimited-style use (1,000/month): pass a ListingLane Pro key (9 USDC/month).

highlights.description: Features: renovated kitchen, fenced yard, near transit...

property.description: Property type and location, e.g. '3-bed townhouse, Austin TX'

name: write_listing_description
